Rail Vision has announced a new quantum error‑correction initiative in partnership with the Israeli Quantum Computing Center (IQCC). The program aims to develop and test robust error‑mitigation techniques for quantum processors, enhancing their reliability and scalability. By collaborating with IQCC researchers, Rail Vision seeks to accelerate practical applications of quantum computing across various industries.
